propositions: A new locked commit-and-push entrypoint must stage and commit dirty tracker changes before delegating to the existing push-only primitive, preserving inbound events and bridge-bot authorship.

The entrypoint must check for active rebase/merge-recovery state before staging: strict mode raises PushDeliveryError with merge-recovery-blocked reason; default mode warns and returns without staging/committing/pushing.
Supplied author identity via git -c user.name/user.email must appear in commit metadata; when omitted, ambient repository identity is used without mutating global or repository config.
Clean but locally-ahead trackers must push without creating empty commits; persistent rejection under strict mode raises PushDeliveryError and preserves the local commit, never returning success.

Lock, stage, and commit failures must raise PushDeliveryError with typed reasons (commit-lock-timeout, stage-failed, commit-failed) in strict mode; default mode warns, returns without push, and retains dirty content for retry.
Existing push_tickets_branch remains push-only and never stages or commits a dirty tree; the new entrypoint is called only after optional commit completes.
